text: Binary per-row check on OC_comments (JSON list of counter-argument comments by non-OP users; order meaningless): returns 1 if at least one comment itself cites a specific, localized example in support of its counter-argument, meaning a particular concrete case, instance, named or identifiable person, place, event, or specific personal experience (real or documented, need not be verified), rather than only general principles, abstract claims, broad statistics or generic hypotheticals. Returns 0 if the list is valid and no comment does so, including a valid empty list; null if OC_comments is missing or malformed. Ignore OP view-change/delta-award announcements, post-outcome thank-you/resolution updates and text reporting whether the outcome occurred as evidence; generic discussion of platform/delta rules is not itself a specific example.
